mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months compresses discount rates, increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a flight to quality in equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) signals weak labor demand, reducing investor confidence and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in slack periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor demand, increasing investor confidence and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 over 3 months indicates weakening domestic supply capacity, compressing future growth and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in home sales (HOUST) above 100 indicates strengthening consumer demand, increasing future earnings expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in home sales (HOUST) below 100 signals softening demand, reducing future earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL index over 3 months indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain higher discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in inflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
